summary: Give Resource Operator its connection details with a Secret (for example aap-access) holding token and host, created with kubectl create -f.
questions: How do I create the connection secret for the Resource Operator?
What keys does the aap-access secret need?
Resource Operator can't connect to AAP

answer_card.title: Resource Operator connection secret
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: aap-access
type: Opaque
stringData:
  token: <generated-token>
  host: https://aap-host.example.com/
```
`kubectl create -f aap-connection-secret.yml`
